title: Tarzan, the boy of the jungle.
lines: Deep in the jungle of Africa lives a family of gorillas.
The mummy gorilla's name is Kala.
One day Kala hears a baby crying.
She finds a human baby, all alone in a tree house.
There's nobody to take care of him.
Kala carefully takes the baby in her arms.
I'll take care of you, says Kala.
Tarzan grows up among the gorillas.
He learns to talk like a gorilla.
He learns to eat like a gorilla.
The other apes sometimes laugh at him.
He learns to swing on vines.
He surfs along the branches of the trees.
He runs as fast as a leopard.
And his other best friend is Tantor.
An elephant who is scared of everything.
He's the best climber in the jungle.
One day Tarzan hears a strange sound.
People are coming into the jungle.
Tarzan has never seen other people before.
One of the people is Jane.
She draws animals in her notebook.
But the little baboon snatches her drawing.
And then the whole baboon family comes after Jane!
He grabs Jane and pulls her through the air.
Tarzan teaches Jane about the jungle.
But there's also a bad man with them.
He wants to catch the gorillas and sell them.
All the animals of the jungle come to help.
They free the gorillas from the cages.
Clayton runs away and never comes back.
Jane is supposed to go back home.
And the whole jungle yells back.
